surface: Authenticated internal warehouse scanner with two approved Bol source contexts

primary_decision.statement: Can the operator scan the current package against the intended Bol account?
primary_decision.primary_action: Confirm the account tab, then scan the package tracking code

items.label: Account selection and active package scan
items.purpose: Keep the selected Bol source explicit immediately before the operator enters a package code.
items.consequence_of_omission: A package could be checked against the wrong source or the operator could mistake a combined queue for account-specific work.

placement.justification: Account context is a safety prerequisite to the repeated scan action.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: The selected source and scanner remain the first decision zone at every viewport.

items.label: Snapshot health and recovery
items.purpose: Make selected-source readiness visible and block scanning when verified live data is not available.
items.consequence_of_omission: An incomplete or stale account snapshot might look safe to scan.

placement.justification: Readiness explains whether the primary scan action is available.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Recovery remains adjacent to the scanner and precedes data tables.

items.demotion_reason: When healthy, readiness is supporting context rather than the operator’s direct action.

items.label: Selected-account progress and safety review
items.purpose: Show only the selected source's worklist and recorded source-qualified progress while preserving shared unassigned STOP review.
items.consequence_of_omission: Operators lose operational context and could overlook a manual review package.

placement.justification: Historical details must not interrupt high-frequency scanning.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Data tables stay downstream and retain their controlled internal overflow.

items.demotion_reason: The next package decision remains more urgent than aggregate and historical context.

items.label: Language and session controls
items.purpose: Retain occasional station utilities without stealing scan focus.
items.consequence_of_omission: Operators lose occasional configuration controls but package decisions remain safe.

placement.justification: Utilities are not part of the package-by-package decision.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Utility controls stay reachable after operational controls and never receive automatic focus.

items.demotion_reason: They are not required to classify the current package.
